edits.text: 1. PURPOSE AND USE. The parties wish to evaluate and, if mutually agreed, negotiate a potential transaction (the “Purpose”). A party disclosing information is a “Disclosing Party,” and a party receiving information is a “Receiving Party.” The Receiving Party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and shall not use it for any other purpose or disclose it except as expressly permitted by this Agreement.
edits.name: Purpose and Use

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY. “Confidential Information” means nonpublic information disclosed by or on behalf of a Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party or its Representatives, in any form, that is identified as confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential in the circumstances. The Receiving Party shall protect Confidential Information using at least the same degree of care it uses to protect its own similar information, and no less than reasonable care, and may disclose it only to its affiliates and its and their respective directors, officers, employees, financing sources, and professional advisers (collectively, “Representatives”) who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations or professional duties of confidentiality. The Receiving Party is responsible for its Representatives’ compliance with this Agreement. Confidential Information does not include information the Receiving Party can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes publicly available other than through breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to it without restriction before disclosure; (c) is received lawfully from a third party without a duty of confidentiality; or (d) is independently developed without use of or reference to Confidential Information. If disclosure is required by law or legal process, the Receiving Party may disclose the required information, provided, to the extent legally permitted, it gives prompt notice to the Disclosing Party and reasonably cooperates, at the Disclosing Party’s expense, in seeking protective treatment. The Receiving Party shall promptly notify the Disclosing Party upon becoming aware of any unauthorized use or disclosure.
edits.name: Confidentiality

edits.text: 3. TERM; SURVIVAL. This Agreement begins on the date of the last signature and remains in effect for twenty-four (24) months, unless either party terminates it earlier by written notice. The Receiving Party’s obligations with respect to each item of Confidential Information continue for three (3) years from the date of its disclosure. Any Confidential Information constituting a trade secret shall remain protected for so long as it remains a trade secret under applicable law.
edits.name: Term and Survival

edits.text: 4. REMEDIES; NO LICENSE. A breach of this Agreement may cause harm for which monetary damages may be inadequate, and the Disclosing Party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief, in addition to any other remedies available at law or in equity. No license or other rights in Confidential Information are granted except the limited right to use it for the Purpose. Neither party is obligated to proceed with any transaction, and no such obligation arises unless and until the parties execute a definitive written agreement.
edits.name: Remedies and No License
